data.body:
**[P2] Preserve prior invocation boundaries in the terminal root**

A fresh clock anchor is created on every resume, so after a backward wall-clock adjustment this terminal timestamp can precede spans exported by an earlier invocation. The new negative-wall-step test explicitly skips root containment, leaving `Workflow`/`DurableExecutionRoot` ending before their child invocation. Keep a per-execution high-water mark of emitted SDK boundaries in both plugins and clamp terminal root completion to it; cross-container skew can remain documented.
